'''Jervett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] businessmen based in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Orrin Gault]] attempted to convince Jervett and two of his colleagues to become members of his [[Settlers' Call Fund]]. However, Jervett was killed during a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Comet Run Day Battle|attack]] on [[Dannar's Claim]].
